svg.text: Source -> publication -> clients -> shared backend -> live data -> backups, recovery and local development
ALIYUN HONG KONG ECS | Linux / Docker / Compose
default: SAME live backend as APK
local archive can also be a recovery source
ONLY AFTER restore + validation: maintainer manually switches the backend database connection
Solid: runtime requests/data access | Dashed: build, publish, backup, snapshot | Dotted: historical migration / manual recovery switch
One shared production backend and primary DB. The public snapshot is public data; Supabase archives support private manual recovery.
